title: Velo Purple Grape Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (10mg)
description: Velo Slim Purple Grape Nicotine Pouches offer the juicy flavour of Red Grapes complemented by a gentle acidic note, creating a profile that tastes fruity, rounded and slightly tangy. The mix of sweetness and acidity gives Purple Grape a distinctive character. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, making them a practical choice for daily use. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of flavours and strengths. Purple Grape is offered here in a Medium 10mg strength, delivering a more potent release compared with lighter options. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
